name: ch.remotli/jobs
title: Remotli
description: Search remote jobs at Swiss companies and CET employers, with verified remote policies.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open remote roles at Swiss companies and companies hiring in the CET time zone, from remotli.ch. Returns up to 20 roles, newest first, each with a plain-text excerpt, the company's verified remote policy when one is on record, the posted salary, and a link to the Remotli job page where the person applies. Pass keywords in query, not a sentence; only the first 5 are used. By default only Fully Remote and Remote-Friendly roles are searched; pass work_mode "all" or a mode to include hybrid and workation roles.

query.description: Keywords, not a sentence (for example "python backend" or "product designer"). Matched case-insensitively against the job title, the company name and the job tags; every keyword must match. Only the first 5 keywords are used.

city.description: A Swiss city slug. "remote" means roles located as remote, "other" means outside the major Swiss cities.

work_mode.description: One work mode, or "all". Default: fully_remote and remote_friendly (the remote-first view the site shows). Hybrid and workation roles appear only with "all" or that mode.

salary_min_chf.description: Yearly floor in CHF. Compares the top of each posted range; a range in another currency is converted to CHF at approximate fixed rates for the comparison (the role still shows its own currency). Roles with no usable posted salary are left out when this is set.

limit.description: How many roles to return, 1 to 20, default 10.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One open role by its slug: the full description as plain text (up to 4000 characters), the work mode, the verified remote policy when on record, the posted salary and the Remotli job page link. longOpen is true for a role older than a year, which is still open but no longer in search results.

slug.description: The job slug, as returned by search_jobs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company by its slug: headquarters, industry, its remote policy as recorded, the verification statement and source when the policy was checked against the company's own site, and its open roles on Remotli (every work mode).

slug.description: The company slug, as returned by search_jobs or get_job.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The job categories with the number of open Fully Remote and Remote-Friendly roles in each. Use a slug from here as the category argument of search_jobs.
